documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Considering And Approving, Among Other Matters, The Unaudited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter Ended June 30, 2026.
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM

analysis.summary: SK Minerals & Additives Limited reported a 50% revenue growth in FY26, closing at Rs. 318 crores, with EBITDA margins increasing to 10%. The company plans to invest approximately Rs. 20 crores in CAPEX over FY27 and FY28 to expand its polymer additives capacity. Management aims to increase the manufacturing contribution to total revenue from 23% to 50% over the next two to three years.

guidance.claim: The company aims to increase the revenue contribution of manufacturing to 50% over the next two to three years.
guidance.quote: Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also.

guidance.claim: The company expects its polymer additives plant to be fully utilized within the next six months.
guidance.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

guidance.claim: The company plans to file three patents within the next six months.
guidance.quote: But in next six months, we will try to file three patents.

demand_outlook.claim: The company experienced a sudden increase in raw material demand from December onwards, with prices rising significantly in February.
demand_outlook.quote: So, as we have came out with an IPO and we have working capital available with us, and we have good amount of funds available. So, we have sourced the material for next six months or suddenly there was demand from December onwards of these raw materials and the prices have increased tremendously in February of these raw materials.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is receiving a tremendous response from buyers for its newly developed additives.
demand_outlook.quote: Again, this is a forward-looking, but I feel the kind of verticals we have ventured in and the kind of response we are receiving from our buyers in terms of additives we have developed is tremendous because as I have specified in my introduction speech also, we are the first company in the polymer additives line where we have ventured in.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is currently focusing its flame-retardant products on the cable, wire, and electrical and electronics equipment industries.
demand_outlook.quote: This flame-retardant is being used in various industries, but currently, we are focusing on cable and wire and electrical and electronics equipment.

demand_outlook.claim: The company plans to target the EV battery segment after catering to cable, wire, and electrical equipment.
demand_outlook.quote: Once we cater to these two segments, then we will target EV batteries also.

capex_expansion.claim: The planned Rs. 20 crores CAPEX is specifically designated for the polymer segment.
capex_expansion.quote: It is for polymer additives. The food we have already set up a plant for. This is going to be specifically in polymer segment where we are developing additives and compounding facility.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to scale its total capacity to 18,000 metric tons in a phased manner over the next 12 to 18 months.
capex_expansion.quote: Basically, we are looking at total capacity of 18,000 metric tons including all the current capacity and this we are going to increase in the phased manner in the next 18 months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has acquired a 9.6-acre land to develop its polymer additives and polymer compound facility.
capex_expansion.quote: First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons.

margins_costs.claim: The company's EBITDA margins increased from 9% to 10% and PAT increased from 5% to 6% in the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: Our financial performance, which is last financial year we have closed is Rs. 318 crores we have closed and this is 50% growth from the Financial Year ‘25 and our EBITDA margins have increased from 9% to 10% and PAT has increased from 5% to 6%.

margins_costs.claim: Margins declined in the second half of FY26 due to rising raw material prices starting from January.
margins_costs.quote: It is because of the increase in the prices of raw materials. And as I have said prices have increased specifically, from January onwards, the prices of raw material have increased.

margins_costs.claim: The company expects gross margins from polymer additives to be approximately 40%.
margins_costs.quote: Currently, in terms of the manufacturing margins, we are standing at 30% approximately, whereas from polymer additives, we feel that the margins would be 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current order book stands at Rs. 55 crores, with Rs. 42 crores coming from government contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of these Rs. 55 crores, Rs. 42 crores is from government and rest is from private.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's current installed capacity is 6,600 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: The current capacity is 6600 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company recently set up a polymer additives plant with a capacity of 400 metric tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's current working capital cycle is 110 days, and management is working to reduce it.
capital_allocation.quote: Currently, working capital cycle is of 110 days. We are trying to reduce this working capital cycle because it will improve in cash flow also in the organization.

capital_allocation.claim: The company plans to fund its capacity expansion using bank credit lines and IPO proceeds.
capital_allocation.quote: We have the credit lines available for CAPEX from the banks also. And we have some part of the IPO proceeds which we have raised for CAPEX.

risks_headwinds.claim: The geopolitical environment has impacted import trading by drying up the company's typical three-month stock.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us. So, that stock is getting dried up.

risks_headwinds.claim: The new polymer additives plant is currently facing teething problems that will take three months to address.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of polymer additives, we have recently set up 400 metric ton plant per month, but there are some teething problems going on which we will try to address in the next three months and that will be also utilized fully in the next six months’ timeline.

management_commitments.claim: The company wants to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50% in the next two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: Currently, 23% of our revenue comes from the manufacturing capabilities, but in the next two to three years, we want to scale the manufacturing contribution to turnover to 50%, with overall increase in turnover also.

management_commitments.claim: The company will try to file three patents in the next six months.
management_commitments.quote: But in next six months, we will try to file three patents.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to scale its manufacturing capacity to 18,000 metric tons in the next 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: Basically, we are looking at total capacity of 18,000 metric tons including all the current capacity and this we are going to increase in the phased manner in the next 18 months.
